user.title: homerunPET
user.description: Paste the token the app already uses (x-token). It is shown in the phone log: open the app, connect the phone with USB debugging and run `adb logcat -d | grep -m1 -oE 'x-token: [^ ]+'`. Reusing it does not log the phone out.

data.allow_password_login: No token: log in with phone and password (risky)

data_description.allow_password_login: A fresh login may log the homerunPET app on your phone out of the account (the cloud keeps one session). If the account is tied to a phone number you cannot receive SMS on, you may lose access. Prefer the token.
